title: docs: update README — 2026-10-02
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: Fresh news, growing stars
gist.blurb: The README gets its daily garden check: fresh Latest News and updated star-history charts.
gist.summary: Refreshes the README's Latest News section and both light and dark star-history SVGs to keep the repository's project snapshot current.
gist.impact: README visitors get updated news and a current view of the project's GitHub star history in either theme.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the pollinations.ai bee updating a garden noticeboard labeled 'NEWS' beside two small star-history charts representing light and dark themes. Stars grow like flowers; the scene should feel like a routine, cheerful update rather than a major launch.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, a small bee wearing a tiny editor's cap pins a 'NEWS' note to a board beside two star-history charts, while lime green (#ecf874) flowers bloom around them. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she shares the frame with the board, never dominates it, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
